I am a woman of 51 years here in Thyolo, and this maize plot is small, only 0.39 hectares, so I must use it well because my family depends on it. I will buy some fertilizer from the subsidy if I can get the coupon, but it is expensive, so I will stretch it. I keep a few chickens and goats, so I put their manure on the plot too, and I plant pigeon peas between the maize to help the soil. I cannot afford to irrigate or hire many people — my children and I do most of the work with hand hoes.
